i1.title: Abercrombie & Fitch Fierce Eau de Cologne 100ml Gift Set with 10ml Travel Spray
i1.descriptionHtml:
The legendary A&F signature, at home and on the go.

Abercrombie & Fitch Fierce Eau de Cologne 100ml Gift Set with 10ml Travel Spray pairs a full-size bottle of the iconic Fierce, first launched in 2002, with a handy travel spray. Lemon, fir, cardamom, orange and petitgrain open freshly, a heart of lily of the valley, rosemary, rose and jasmine follows, and it settles on oakmoss, Brazilian rosewood, musk and vetiver.

What's in the set

  • Fierce Eau de Cologne 100ml (spray)
  • Fierce Eau de Cologne 10ml (travel spray)

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Lemon, Fir, Cardamom, Orange, Petitgrain
  • Heart: Lily of the Valley, Rosemary, Rose, Jasmine
  • Base: Oakmoss, Brazilian Rosewood, Musk, Vetiver

Key details

  • Brand: Abercrombie & Fitch
  • Concentration: Eau de Cologne
  • Contents: Fierce Eau de Cologne 100ml + Fierce Eau de Cologne 10ml
  • Scent profile: Aromatic · Woody · Fresh
  • Wear: Men

Why you'll love it

  • The iconic A&F signature scent
  • Fresh citrus and fir with a hint of cardamom
  • Travel spray for your bag or gym kit
  • Ready to give as a gift

FAQ

What does Fierce smell like?

Lemon, fir, cardamom, orange and petitgrain first, then lily of the valley, rosemary, rose and jasmine, finishing with oakmoss, Brazilian rosewood, musk and vetiver.

What's in the set?

Fierce Eau de Cologne 100ml (spray); Fierce Eau de Cologne 10ml (travel spray).

Is it for men?

Yes, it is a men's fragrance gift set.
